rules: Retain original source and clean baseline; transformed source/IR is an additional artifact where available.
Record stripped, packed, optimized and obfuscated as distinct attributes.
Never claim semantic equivalence from a successful compiler exit code.
Tools that intentionally remove debug mappings remain raw with explicit unavailable ground truth.
Archived, unlicensed or noncommercial-only tools require explicit review before campaign admission.
No corpus-produced code is executed by generation; semantic validation is a separate future qualification stage.
